newsitem.title: USA: HarperCollins cancels bevy of books - NYT.
newsitem.headline: HarperCollins cancels bevy of books - NYT.

text.p: HarperCollins, the publishing house of News Corp Ltd, is scaling back its book lists, cancelling about 100 titles and finished manuscripts, the New York Times said.
In Friday's edition, the Times said the cost-cutting measure is a sign of the times for the publishing industry.
In the past two weeks alone, HarperCollins has cancelled 36 titles. Those on the hit list include novels, cookbooks, a mystery, a biography and a European travel guide.
An additional 70 books were cancelled because the authors missed their contractual deadlines, a common occurrence that the industry usually tolerates.

"It's a way of trying to make sense out of the business," HarperCollins Chief Executive Anthea Disney told the Times. "In all honesty, I don't want to publish books that we won't get behind and publish well."
